Positions.title: Ph.D. & M.S. Research Scholar Positions — January 2027 Intake
Positions.description: The Department of Aerospace Engineering, IIT Madras, invites applications from motivated candidates for full-time Ph.D. and M.S. research scholar positions in Micromechanics, Experimental Mechanics, Fracture Mechanics and Polymer Composite Materials. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview and offered institute fellowship support.
Positions.eligibility: Master's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Materials Engineering.
